content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee E033: Jennifer Martin requests admin access to Payroll.

Two notes with conflicting info:
- Note 1 (HR): role Analyst, full_time employee. For full-time employees, max is write (admin only if role owns system). Analyst doesn't own Payroll (Payroll Specialist owns it). So max = write.
- Note 2 (Security): role Analyst, contractor, basic security training. Contractors max at read (or write if advanced security training), never admin. So max = read.

The security note says security record is authoritative regarding employment type (contractor, basic training). So max access = read.

Requested: admin. Requested is above maximum (read), so grant maximum = read.

Submit decision: read.
